static_traits.name: Emily
static_traits.social_status: Has friends in the industry to confide in, but finds it hard to discuss one's relationship beliefs with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；曾在第二次离婚后短暂接受心理咨询，但not yet进行长期治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高、略显紧张；能主动描述负性信念与trigger情境，态度积极、愿意尝试改变

basic_info.main_problem: 我有一个信念：因为有过三次离婚，我将永远without法与人长期在一起。这一信念导致我感到Loneliness和悲观。
basic_info.core_demands: I am seeking counseling again, because this belief is affecting my mental health and hindering me from building meaningful connections with others. I hope to improve the situation and learn to challenge these negative thoughts.
growth_experiences: 三段婚姻均以离婚告终：第三次离婚发生在两年前，自此形成“我永远without法与人长期在一起”的信念；起初压力很大，感觉自己在关系中是个失败者。随着每一次婚姻失败，这一信念not断Reinforcement，使其难以信任潜在伴侣，并在遇到新的人或尝试约会时反复出现，导致回避与长期承诺。
原生家庭背景：父亲是著名Actor，来访者成长在演艺环境中。该背景与其当前职业相连，但在关系层面的具体影响not yet进一步描述。

core_beliefs: 我注定without法拥有长期稳定的亲密关系
我在亲密关系中是个失败者

special_situations.event: Trying to date someone newly met
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I start a new relationship, I will inevitably repeat past failures
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not会长久，我又会把事情搞砸

special_situations.event: 听到朋友Engaged或结婚的消息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人能稳定而我not能，说明我有问题且not值得被选择
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing、避免谈论亲密关系以逃避比较与评价

special_situations.event: 回想自己三次离婚的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 有过三次离婚的人注定without法拥有长期关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 对潜在伴侣保持not信任、避免深入承诺

core_conflict.wish: 渴望拥有稳定、被信任与被爱的长期亲密关系
core_conflict.fear: 害怕长期承诺再次带来失败与Being rejected，令自己更受伤
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of failure and being hurt by avoiding dating and intimate contact
保持疏离以保护自尊与情绪稳定

object_relations.self_representation: 失败的伴侣、not会被长期选择的人
object_relations.object_representation: 潜在伴侣是挑剔且终会离开的拒绝者
朋友与同龄人是更成功、更稳定的参照对象

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores starting dating or proposes behavioral experiments to test their negative predictions about relationships
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于将再次尝试亲密关系理解为必然重演失败，感觉被推动去面对会hurt oneself的事情
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing in an indirect, cautious tone the fact of three past divorces as a reason to refuse trying, raising many concerns, tending to postpone or lower the intensity of action.

manifestations: 在第三次离婚后形成“我将永远找not到长期伴侣”的信念
遇到新的人或听到朋友婚讯时ReinforcementLoneliness与悲观感受
因难以信任潜在伴侣而回避约会与承诺

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: 有约会或深入连接的冲动时选择克制与回避
将关系中的失望与悲伤向内承受，not与朋友谈论
把精力从人际转向Self-denial与担忧

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 反复自责“我会把事情搞砸”
过度预判关系结果而Repression行动
在社交与约会时过度谨慎、Withdrawal

positive_force: 愿意再次寻求心理咨询，态度积极
愿意尝试记录日记与认知练习，具有改变动机
在行业内有朋友可提供情感支持
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括与预测not yet来的认知模式
对长期承诺的恐惧与not信任，导致回避约会
Self-denial与将失败贴标签的思维，ReinforcementLoneliness与悲观
社交比较引发的自卑与羞愧

target_behavior.behavior: 回避约会与长期承诺（伴随Loneliness与悲观）
antecedent: Trying to date someone newly met
听到朋友Engaged或结婚的消息
target_behavior.core_reason: 将过往三次离婚过度概括为“注定失败”，灾难化预测not yet来并担心再次受伤，导致对潜在伴侣缺乏信任
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的拒绝与失败，保护自尊与情绪安全
target_behavior.consequence: 难以形成深层连接，持续Loneliness与悲观，工作Decreased drive、注意力受影响
